name: Stormwind City Outskirts
summary: Tucked directly beyond the sturdy stone ramparts behind the Dwarven District, the Stormwind City Outskirts offer a quiet pocket of rural calm. With a modest farmhouse and a still pond nestled under the shadow of the mountains, it stands in stark contrast to the clatter of the capital. It serves as a brief, peaceful respite just paces away from the bustling city streets.

sections.title: A Quiet Corner Outside the Walls
sections.body: While the Grand Alliance bustles with political maneuvering, trade, and military musters, the quiet hollow behind the Dwarven District remains untouched by the city's frenzy. Accessible through small passages leading out through the wall, this small rural plot features only a solitary farmhouse alongside a scenic pond. It reflects the simpler, pastoral roots of the kingdom of Stormwind—a reminder of rural life quietly flourishing in the sheltered crags beneath the high capital fortifications.

faq.q: Where are the Stormwind City Outskirts located?
faq.answer: The outskirts are situated just outside the northern defensive walls of Stormwind City. You can reach them directly from the back of the Dwarven District, passing out through the ramparts into a secluded pocket nestled against the mountains.

The area is exceptionally modest, consisting primarily of a tranquil freshwater pond and a small rural farmhouse. It is a quiet, out-of-the-way nook free from the heavy foot traffic of the urban districts.
A few locals, such as Aressa, can be found tending to their quiet routines here, alongside beasts like Trained Brightlances that stay sheltered away from the city center.

faq.q: Is there any danger in this area?
faq.answer: No. The outskirts remain completely safe and protected under the defensive envelope of Stormwind's northern walls, making it an undisturbed spot to catch your breath.

angles.text: For citizens of Stormwind, this hidden pastoral tract serves as a quiet reminder of the simpler homesteads and farmland scattered throughout the kingdom's surrounding countryside.
Tucked away behind the Dwarven District, this hidden retreat provides Alliance travelers a tranquil escape from the noise and intrigue of the capital.
